result.summary: Found several visual issues: a loading spinner stuck over restaurant content, truncated restaurant names, and a cut-off category chip.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner is overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, obscuring the food photo while the rest of the card (title, rating, meta) is already fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Hide or remove the spinner once the image/content has loaded, or use a skeleton/placeholder that does not block the main visual after data is ready.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or full title visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant names wrap to two lines, shrink text, or truncate with an ellipsis so the name is not abruptly cut off.

issues.description: The category filter row shows a partial empty/white chip on the far right edge beyond 'Healthy', looking like a broken or incomplete control.
issues.suggestion: Clip the horizontal scroller cleanly at the screen edge or ensure only full chips (or a deliberate fade) are shown without a stray partial empty pill.
